includesTitle: What a standard split AC installation includes
includes: Checking the wall and choosing the right spot for both units
Mounting the indoor unit level on its bracket
Placing the outdoor unit with enough space for airflow
Connecting copper pipes, drain pipe and wiring
Vacuuming the lines so moisture and air don't damage the compressor
Cooling test and a quick demo of the remote and settings
Cleaning up the dust and packing waste before we leave

jobs.title: New split AC installation
jobs.text: For a new AC from any brand or shop. We fit both units, connect the pipes supplied with the AC, vacuum the lines and test cooling. If the outdoor unit is far from the indoor unit, extra copper pipe is charged per foot, and we measure this with you first.

jobs.title: Window AC installation
jobs.text: We fit the AC into an existing window or wall opening, seal the gaps so hot air and dust stay out, set a slight outward tilt for drainage and check the power point can take the load.

jobs.title: AC removal (uninstallation)
jobs.text: Before disconnecting a split AC we pump the gas back into the outdoor unit, so it isn't lost and the AC can be reinstalled later without a full refill. Pipes are capped, both units are taken down carefully and the wall bracket can be removed too.

jobs.title: Moving house? Removal + reinstallation
jobs.text: We remove the AC at your old home and fit it at the new one. If the old pipes are too short or damaged for the new layout, new pipe is added. If some gas was lost during the move, a top-up is quoted before it's done.

faq.q: What are AC installation charges in Ahmedabad?
faq.a: Split AC installation usually costs ₹1,200 to ₹1,800 for up to 1.5 ton and ₹1,500 to ₹2,200 for 2 ton. Window AC installation is around ₹600 to ₹1,000. Extra copper pipe, a stand or a new wall hole are charged only if your site needs them.

faq.q: How long does split AC installation take?
faq.a: A standard split AC installation takes about 2 to 3 hours. It can take longer if a new wall hole, a long pipe run or a stand is needed.
Split AC removal is typically ₹500 to ₹800, including pumping the gas down into the outdoor unit. Window AC removal is around ₹300 to ₹500.

faq.q: Do I need a gas refill after moving my AC?
faq.a: Not always. If the gas was pumped down properly before removal, most ACs only need a check after reinstallation. A top-up is needed only if gas was lost, and we quote it before doing it.

faq.q: Why is extra copper pipe charged?
faq.a: An AC comes with a short length of pipe, usually around 3 metres. If the outdoor unit has to sit further away, extra pipe is needed and is charged per foot. We measure the run with you before fitting.

faq.q: Do you install all AC brands?
faq.a: Yes. We install split and window ACs of all common brands, whether you bought the AC online or from a local shop.
